Class GymSystem

java.lang.Object
com.project.gymsys.business.GymSystem
public class GymSystem extends Object
Version:
1.0 Central business logic controller for the Gym Administration System. This class acts as the bridge between the UI layer and the data layer. All operations on employees and members are handled here (Req-16). The UI should never directly manipulate the data lists.
